name: Spinbloom
author: Texaco (based on Solfa by SirAllap)
description: Spinbloom — a YouTube Music player for the Omarchy bar: discs that spin in, colours that bloom out, frosted glass, search, queue, library, lyrics and likes. Based on Solfa by SirAllap.

barWidget.description: Now playing with a round cover, quick controls, and a panel for search, queue, library and lyrics

schema.label: Previous, play/pause and next in the bar
Show in the bar when nothing is loaded
Shortcuts: Super+Alt+M panel, Super+Alt+P play/pause, Super+Alt+N next, Super+Alt+B previous, Super+Alt+L like; a taken key falls back to another (never takes a key another app uses)
Start YouTube Music with the shell
Browser for the engine
schema.description: An absolute path to a Chromium-family browser executable, e.g. /usr/bin/brave. Empty: the first found of chromium, google-chrome-stable, brave, brave-browser, vivaldi-stable, microsoft-edge-stable.

schema.label: With Brave, let its ad blocker fetch its filter lists
schema.description: Only for a Brave engine, and only worth it without Premium: Brave then updates its components in the background (more traffic, about 25 MB more memory).

schema.label: Equalizer preset
schema.description: flat, bass, treble, vocal, loudness or custom.

schema.label: Equalizer band gains, dB (JSON array, 10 bands 32 Hz-16 kHz)
When Spinbloom starts, resume paused instead of playing
Volume when Spinbloom starts
schema.description: "last" (the volume it had) or a 0-100 percent.

schema.label: Refresh the page past this JS heap (MB)
Refresh the page at least every (hours)
Artwork style
schema.description: dial (a wheel of CDs under the cover) or flow (covers side by side).

schema.label: Smaller size the corner button uses
CD wheel in the Compact and Small sizes
Motion
schema.description: full, or reduced (Calm motion: simple fades instead of flying discs and swirls).

schema.label: Use desktop blur for the player's frosted glass
schema.description: When Hyprland blur is off, Spinbloom turns it on for its own player only while it runs. Nothing is written to your config files.
